newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures rise due to fall in stocks.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures rise due to fall in stocks.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended firmer across the board on Monday, encouraged by news Japan's rubber stocks as of November 10 declined sharply, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.2 yen to 2.7 yen per kg higher. The benchmark April contract ended 1.3 yen per kg up at 142.9 yen.
"Larger-than-expected falls in Japan's rubber stocks fuelled short-covering," an analyst at a commodity broker said.

Traders said the decline in rubber stocks helped improve market sentiment, but also said further gains could be capped by the yen's firmer tendency against the dollar. -- Tokyo Commodity Desk +81-3-3432-7391
